editorial.blurb: Pegasus Taverna is a beloved Greektown institution serving authentic Mediterranean fare with genuine warmth and late-night hours that keep the neighborhood fed and happy.
editorial.insiderTip: Open until 2am on Saturdays—perfect for post-concert dining. Arrive ready to order the Saganaki (flaming cheese) tableside, and don't skip the Lemon Rice Soup, which reviewers call absolutely unforgettable.
